parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
arduous[d:rd3uas]adj.
When something is arduous, it demands great effort or labor.
→ The explorers began their arduous hike up the steep mountain.
😎
attain[stein]v.
To attain something means to gain or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.
→ In two more years, I will attain my high school diploma.
😎
coexist[kouigzistl]v.
To coexist with something means to exist with it in the same time and place.
→ Our pets coexist at our home with little or no problems.
😎
conceive[kansiv]v.
To conceive something means to be able to imagine or believe it.
→ The child could not conceive the actual size of the Earth.
😎
dubious[dyu bias]adj.
When something or someone is dubious, they are not considered honest.
→ The police thought that the man’s description of the crime was dubious.
😎
ego[i:gou]n.
An ego is a person’s sense of their own worth.
→ Kelly’s ego made her think that she was some kind of a superhero.
😎
elastic[ilaestik]adj.
Elastic is a rubber that stretches when it is pulled.
→ He attached the elastic bungee to his legs before he jumped off the platform.
😎
endeavor[eridevar]n.
An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.
→ The company’s new advertising endeavor ended in a horrible failure.
😎
engrave[ingreiv]v.
To engrave means to cut a design or words into the surface of something.
→ The couple engraved their names onto the old pine tree.
😎
excavate[ekskaveit]v.
To excavate means to dig on land and remove dirt to look for something.
→ The team wishes to excavate the site in hopes of finding fossils.
😎
jagged[d3£fegid]adj.
When something is jagged, it has a tough, uneven shape or edge.
→ The swimmer was hurt when he fell on the jagged rocks.
😎
locale[loukaei]n.
A locale is a small area or place where something specific happens.
→ The spa was the perfect locale for my mother to relax and enjoy her vacation.
😎
mold[mould]n.
A mold is a hollow container that is used to make certain shapes.
→ Using a cupcake mold will ensure that they come out just right.
😎
outright[autrait]adj.
When something is outright, it is open and direct.
→ Everyone knew that the boy’s story was an outright lie.
😎
periphery[pari:fari]n.
The periphery of an area, place, or thing is the edge of it.
→ A beautiful floral pattern is on the periphery of the stationery.
😎
plaster[plaestar]n.
Plaster is a smooth paste that gets hard when it dries.
→ He used plaster to fill in the cracks in the old walls.
😎
shovel[/Aval]n.
A shovel is a tool with a long handle that is used for digging.
→ The boy grabbed his shovel and got all of the snow off of the sidewalk.
😎
skeletal[skelatl]adj.
When something is skeletal, it relates to bones in the body.
→ We studied the skeletal system in anatomy class.
😎
terrestrial[tarestriai]adj.
If something is terrestrial, it relates to Earth.
→ There are billions of terrestrial life forms.
😎
vicious[vijas]adj.
When something or someone is vicious, they are violent and cruel.
→ The vicious dog tried to bite the small child.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content:
He chose to make his sculpture out of a smooth paste that hardens when it dries. [ 1 ]

Our violent and cruel boss forced us to work twelve hours in a row without a break. [ 2 ]

The race was close, so it was difficult to determine an open and direct winner. [ 3 ]

This is the perfect small area where something happens for a picnic. [ 4 ]

Truck drivers often stay awake for many hours to make their difficult and tiring drives. [ 5 ]

The salesperson’s claim seemed quite dishonest, unsafe, and unreliable. [ 6 ]

Mike was thrilled to pass the driving test and gain his driver’s license. [ 7 ]

Physics on the moon are much different than Earth-related physics. [ 8 ]

The prisoners were unable to imagine and believe a plot for escaping the jail. [ 9 ]

To plant these seeds, I will first need to buy a tool used for digging. [ 10 ]
questions.explanation: plaster (n): a smooth paste that gets hard when it dries.
vicious (adj): violent and cruel.
outright (adj): open and direct.
locale (n): a small area or place where something specific happens.
arduous (adj): demands great effort or labor.
dubious (adj): not considered honest.
attain (v): to gain or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.
terrestrial (adj): relates to Earth.
conceive (v): to be able to imagine or believe it.
shovel (n): a tool with a long handle that is used for digging.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: What might a person with a large ego say?
questions.explanation: An ego is a person’s sense of their own worth.

questions.content: Which is likely to be jagged?
questions.explanation: Jagged means having a tough, uneven shape or edge.

questions.content: Which is likely to be excavated?
questions.explanation: To excavate means to dig on land and remove dirt.

questions.content: What is part of the skeletal system?
questions.explanation: Skeletal relates to bones in the body.

questions.explanation: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: The alarm clock was set to endeavor every morning at seven A.M.
questions.explanation: Endeavor means an attempt to do something new, not ring.

questions.content: Experts excavated the site in hopes of finding an ancient city buried underneath.
questions.explanation: Excavate means to dig on land.

questions.content: Everyone loved to hug and kiss the vicious baby.
questions.explanation: Vicious means violent and cruel.

questions.content: The elephant is one of the largest terrestrial animals still in existence.
questions.explanation: Terrestrial means relating to Earth (land animals).

questions.content: The dubious chocolate ice cream is a favorite treat at the restaurant.
questions.explanation: Dubious means not considered honest.

questions.content: The concerned owner built a fence along the periphery of the parking lot.
questions.explanation: Periphery means the edge of an area.

questions.content: Preparing for the difficult test was an arduous task for the nervous students.
questions.explanation: Arduous means demanding great effort or labor.

questions.content: You’ll need a shovel if you plan on getting on top of the roof.
questions.explanation: A shovel is used for digging, not climbing.

questions.content: The delicate flower was a jagged addition to the arrangement.
questions.explanation: Jagged means tough, uneven shape or edge.

questions.content: Children cheered as the circus clown attained balloons into different shapes.
questions.explanation: Attain means to gain or achieve, not shape or twist.

questions.content: He filled the ugly holes in the ceiling with plaster.
questions.explanation: Plaster is a smooth paste that hardens.

questions.content: At the factory, the workers made screws by pouring liquid metal into a mold.
questions.explanation: A mold is a hollow container to make shapes.

questions.content: I hope she is able to engrave all of her homework before school tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Engrave means to cut a design into a surface, not complete homework.

questions.content: I cannot conceive the reason why he would act in such a mean way.
questions.explanation: Conceive means to imagine or believe.

questions.content: The small fights and arguments eventually led to an outright war.
questions.explanation: Outright means open and direct.

questions.content: When the glass vase fell to the floor, we heard an elastic sound.
questions.explanation: Elastic relates to stretching, not sound.

questions.content: She bought a cute new ego from the pet store today.
questions.explanation: Ego is a person's sense of self-worth, not an animal.

questions.content: We need to choose a locale for Brian’s birthday party.
questions.explanation: Locale is a small area or place.

questions.content: Derrick bought a skeletal from that new clothing store downtown.
questions.explanation: Skeletal relates to bones, not clothing.

questions.content: Although they were rivals, the stores were able to coexist in the same neighborhood.
questions.explanation: Coexist means to exist together in the same time and place.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Fossil Hunters

Tim and Dean were great fossil hunters. They were the very best at finding dinosaur bones. Although Tim and Dean were quite similar, they were outright enemies. The two men got into vicious arguments all the time. They couldn’t coexist peacefully because their egos were too large. Tim thought he was the best fossil hunter, while Dean was sure that he was much better than Tim.

One day, Tim was searching for fossils on the periphery of the city when he discovered a huge bone. He had never seen anything like it! He took his shovel and carefully excavated the dirt around it. As he dug, he uncovered more jagged bones. He realized that he had found an entire dinosaur skeleton! Tim couldn’t conceive a plan to remove the huge skeleton all by himself. Such an endeavor would be too arduous. He needed help. He tried to think of people who would be capable of helping him remove the skeleton without breaking it. The only person Tim could think of was Dean, his enemy.

Tim ran into the city to find Dean. Tim found him and said, “Dean, I’ve found the skeletal remains of a huge terrestrial animal. But I can’t get the skeleton out by myself. Will you please help me?”

Dean thought that Tim’s claim might be dubious. He replied, “If you’re serious about the skeleton, I’ll help.”

Tim excitedly showed Dean the skeleton’s locale. They worked together to carefully remove each bone. And to keep the bones together, they tied them with elastic strips. When they were finished, they had attained a perfect skeleton. They used plaster to make a mold of the dinosaur’s skull. They engraved their initials into it and gave it to the curator of a local museum.

Tim and Dean found out that they could work very well together. They decided to end their feud and become friends. By combining their talents, the men became even greater than they were before.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: Tim and Dean were outright enemies who got into vicious arguments.
questions.explanation: Câu này là True (Đúng) nhé. Ngay đoạn 1 có viết: '...they were outright enemies. The two men got into vicious arguments all the time.' (...họ là những kẻ thù hoàn toàn của nhau. Hai người đàn ông này lúc nào cũng vướng vào những cuộc tranh cãi ác ý). Câu hỏi phản ánh đúng y chang thông tin này !

questions.content: Tim and Dean removed the jagged bones and used elastic to attain them.
questions.explanation: Câu này là False (Sai) . Đoạn 5 cho biết họ cẩn thận lấy từng khúc xương ra, sau đó: 'And to keep the bones together, they tied them with elastic strips.' (Và để giữ các khúc xương lại với nhau, họ đã buộc chúng bằng các dải thun). Họ dùng dây thun để 'buộc chúng lại' (tie them together) chứ không phải để 'đạt được chúng' (attain them) như câu hỏi viết đâu nhé.

questions.content: Tim couldn’t conceive a plan to remove the bones because the endeavor would be too arduous.
questions.explanation: Câu này là True (Đúng) nhé. Trong đoạn 2 có câu: 'Tim couldn’t conceive a plan to remove the huge skeleton all by himself. Such an endeavor would be too arduous.' (Tim không thể hình dung ra một kế hoạch để tự mình gỡ bỏ bộ xương khổng lồ. Một nỗ lực như vậy sẽ quá gian khổ). Hoàn toàn khớp với ý của câu hỏi luôn!

questions.content: Dean thought that Tim’s ego might be dubious.
questions.explanation: Câu này là False (Sai) . Bạn xem đoạn 4 sẽ thấy: 'Dean thought that Tim’s claim might be dubious.' (Dean nghĩ rằng lời khẳng định của Tim có thể là đáng ngờ). Chứ không phải 'Tim's ego' (cái tôi của Tim) đáng ngờ đâu nhé!

questions.content: When Tim excavated the land, he uncovered many engraved bones.
questions.explanation: Câu này là False (Sai) . Đoạn 2 ghi rất rõ: '...excavated the dirt around it. As he dug, he uncovered more jagged bones.' (...đào lớp bụi bẩn xung quanh nó. Khi đào, anh ấy phát hiện ra nhiều đoạn xương lởm chởm hơn). Vậy xương ở đây là 'jagged bones' (lởm chởm) chứ không phải 'engraved bones' (xương được khắc chữ) nhé!

questions.content: Why couldn’t Tim and Dean coexist peacefully?
options: They wanted to attain different goals.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A nhé. Để biết tại sao Tim và Dean không thể chung sống hòa bình, bạn nhìn vào đoạn 1: 'They couldn’t coexist peacefully because their egos were too large.' (Họ không thể cùng tồn tại một cách hòa bình bởi vì cái tôi của họ quá lớn). Vậy chọn A là chuẩn xác nhất !

questions.content: What did Tim use his shovel to do?
options: Tim used his shovel to carefully excavate the land around the bone.
Tim used his shovel to hit Dean.
Tim used his shovel to build a house.
Tim used his shovel to engrave his name.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A . Đoạn 2 miêu tả việc Tim dùng xẻng làm gì: 'He took his shovel and carefully excavated the dirt around it.' (Anh ấy lấy chiếc xẻng của mình và cẩn thận đào lớp bụi bẩn xung quanh nó). Vậy đáp án A diễn tả chính xác hành động này nhé!

questions.content: What was Tim doing on the periphery of the city?
options: Tim was looking for a new locale.
Tim was trying to attain a diploma.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A nhé. Ngay câu đầu tiên của đoạn 2 đã viết: 'One day, Tim was searching for fossils on the periphery of the city...' (Một ngày nọ, Tim đang tìm kiếm hóa thạch ở vùng ngoại ô thành phố...). Rất rõ ràng phải không nào!

questions.content: What did the fossil hunters do to the plaster mold before they gave it to the curator?
options: They engraved their initials into it.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A . Đoạn 5 có nhắc đến: 'They used plaster to make a mold... They engraved their initials into it and gave it to the curator...' (Họ đã sử dụng thạch cao để tạo khuôn... Họ khắc tên viết tắt của mình vào đó và đưa nó cho người phụ trách...). Nên đáp án đúng phải là A nhé!

questions.content: What did Dean say before he went to the locale of the terrestrial animal’s skeletal remains?
options: “If you’re serious about the skeleton, I’ll help.”
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A nhé. Ở đoạn 4, Dean đã đáp lại lời nhờ vả của Tim rằng: 'If you’re serious about the skeleton, I’ll help.' (Nếu bạn nghiêm túc về bộ xương, tôi sẽ giúp). Vậy A là lựa chọn chính xác !
